description: This Java source file defines an Android service class 'SampleSpellCheckerService' extending 'SpellCheckerService'. It provides implementations for creating spell checker sessions and handling suggestions logic, including sentence-level suggestions. The class includes an inner static class 'AndroidSpellCheckerSession' that manages suggestion generation and sentence suggestions, with mock logic and platform version checks.
